configurations.name: Nyalakan iOS simulator
configurations.command: IFS=$'\n'; select d in $(xcrun simctl list devices available | grep -E '(iPhone|iPad)' | sed 's/^ *//'); do xcrun simctl boot "$(echo "$d" | grep -oE '[0-9A-F-]{36}')"; open -a Simulator; break; done

configurations.name: Nyalakan Android emulator
configurations.command: select a in $(~/Library/Android/sdk/emulator/emulator -list-avds); do nohup ~/Library/Android/sdk/emulator/emulator -avd "$a" >/dev/null 2>&1 & break; done
